title: Extra stakeholder / AIS group requested

request.summary: Prime asks to add Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS) as a fourth application group beside ESS/RIS/IAM.
request.exact_edit: Do not expand the 12-cell matrix to 16 cells in the base package. Record a proposed additional_group change: HRIS x four dimensions, separately priced, not authorized.

artifact.before: Scope matrix (authorized base): ESS, RIS, IAM x software/security/deployment/ai_readiness = 12 cells.
artifact.after:
Scope matrix (authorized base): ESS, RIS, IAM x software/security/deployment/ai_readiness = 12 cells.
OPEN-SCOPE: HRIS requested as a fourth group. NOT added. Proposed incremental catalog additional_group 32h / $2,400 HYPOTHETICAL / NOT ACCEPTED. Requires separate written authorization (Section 7).

rationale: Section 7 lists additional system/application groups outside the agreed frame as change-control, not silent expansion of the $24,000 base. The 12-cell matrix stays ESS/RIS/IAM. Effort cites the published UIOWA-133 additional_group planning number as a labeled hypothesis, not an invoice. Kickoff/draft/final triggers in Section 2 are untouched.
